goal: A dependency-free GTFS reader that opens a feed zip and yields a typed in-memory feed model. It is the entry point for all transit data and replaces upstream's just_gtfs dependency.

Column lookup by header name so column order does not matter; unknown columns ignored
Feed model stored in arenas with interned strings and ids mapped to dense u32
notes: Zero external deps: Zig std only
stop_times is the large table: parse it in parallel chunks and keep it columnar
See docs/upstream/valhalla-architecture.md section 5 for the upstream ingest flow
accept: Parses at least three public feeds of different sizes with row counts matching a reference count of the CSV files

stop_times throughput of at least 5 million rows per second on 8 cores
zig build test green

Lift upstream limits: 64-day schedule window, 12-bit route and schedule indices
notes: Field inventory for TransitDeparture, TransitStop, TransitRoute, TransitSchedule and TransitTransfer is in docs/upstream/valhalla-architecture.md section 3
On-disk rules from docs/design/engine-and-format.md: extern struct with packed struct(u32) members only, little-endian
accept: Round-trip test: write then read every record type with all fields preserved
